why: One filing per KNOWN defect class, pinned. The local corpus is sampled by
assets and therefore contains whatever is common, not what is broken:
diff-lineups.mjs reported 'no changes' for v101, v103 and v104 because not
one of those classes was in it. Three fixes shipped on a single-filing check
because the tool that should have measured them was looking elsewhere.
diff-lineups ensures every ack here is present before it compares, so a
regression in any solved class fails loudly instead of silently.
Add an entry whenever a parser version fixes a new class. Never remove one.
